main_text.p: Hæc ille. Alia adhuc nominis ratio apud AlMotar-rezium in libro Mogreb affertur, اشتقاقها (inquit) من الصلا وهو العظم الذي عليه الاليتين لان المصلي يحرك صلبه في الركوع والسجود Derivatur à صلا quod os illud denotat cui adherent clu-nes, quoniam qui orat clunium esse movet, dum se incur-vat & fronte terræ admotâ prosternitur. v. & AlGefhaf, & AlBidawi, ad cap. vacce in Alc. Epit. AlGazal. Monent eo-rum cordatiores in oratione præcipuè spectari partes internas, quæ sint بمنزلة المعاني الباطنة tanquam ejus vita & spiritus quarum sex præcipuas statuunt حضور القلب والتفهم والتعظيم والهيبة والرجا والحيا Præsentiam cordis [seu Intentionem] Intellectum, συνεσιν[?], Reverentiam, Spem, Pudorem. Exteriori tamen formâ & corporis gestibus, quales sunt inflexio corporis quæ الركوع vo-catur, & frontis terræ admotio quæ السجود aliisque circumstantiarum minutiis adeo solliciti sunt, neg-lectis forsan plerunque iis quæ cor spectent, ut non immeritò inde & nomen apud ipsos fortiatur, & de-finitionem, sic describente Ebnol Kassaio, quòd sit عبارة عن افعال مخصوصة واركان معلومة بشرايط مخصوصة في اوقات مقدرة cultus constans actionibus peculiaribus, & fundamentis notis cum certis conditionibus tempore definito [ peragendis. ] Actionum istarum quasnam à majoribus acceptas retinuerit Mohammedes, quasnam ipse pro arbitrio suo addiderit, difficile erit statuere. Quod ad illam autem,

page.notes: Arabic and Greek transcribed from a small, slightly blurred scan; the Arabic words were copied as far as legible, but the exact letters of the long Arabic phrases should be checked against the original. The Greek word after "Intellectum," is uncertain (marked [?]). The margin note's "Epit." and "AlGazal." are copied as printed, with the spacing as on the scan. Page number 305 and the running head NOTÆ are printed at the top; catchword "magni" and signature "Rr 2" are at the foot.
